slides.eyebrow: Just got your offer accepted in NJ?
slides.sub: The four steps between a signed contract and closing day.

slides.title: Attorney review
slides.body: Each side's attorney can approve the contract, ask for changes, or disapprove it. Some reviews wrap up in 24 hours, while others take longer. The deadline to object is 3 business days.

slides.title: Home inspection
slides.body: An inspector checks the home's condition. Plan to schedule it within 10 to 14 days of the accepted offer. The report usually arrives within 24 to 48 hours.

slides.title: Appraisal and title search
slides.body: If you're financing, an appraisal checks the home's value, usually in 7 to 14 days. Your attorney handles the title search.

slides.title: Walk-through and closing
slides.body: Your final walk-through is 24 to 48 hours before closing. Closing itself often takes 60 to 90 minutes. From accepted offer to closing, expect about 30 to 60 days.

caption:
Just got your offer accepted in New Jersey? Here's what happens before you get the keys.

First comes attorney review. Some reviews wrap up in 24 hours, while others take longer. The deadline to object is 3 business days. Next is the home inspection, then the appraisal and title search. Last is the final walk-through and closing. From accepted offer to closing, expect about 30 to 60 days.
